title: Meet Dynamic Individual Preferences: Resolving Conflicting Human Value with Paired Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks the 'Value Conflict Dilemma' (VCD) dataset, which evaluates Large Language Models on their ability to resolve scenarios involving conflicting human values like risk-taking versus risk-aversion and competitive versus collaborative social strategies. This core component focuses on evaluating value-based decision-making and ethics.
